CustomField.description: How long a conversation's processing lock (AIConversation__c.ProcessingLockedUntil__c) lasts before it expires on its own. The lock is normally released as soon as the turn ends; this is the safety net if it isn't. Must be longer than a turn takes to queue and run. Blank or below 1 falls back to the code default (10).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Safety-net expiry for a conversation's processing lock, in minutes.
CustomField.label: Processing Lock Minutes
